title: Transfer learning guides experimental discovery of oxygen-evolution perovskites
summary: A pretrained model, ensemble learning and active learning screened 16,050 compositions. The paper reports synthesis of 36 predicted oxides, including 13 pure perovskite structures. Two selected Pr–Sr–Co–Fe(-Mn) materials showed overpotentials of 327 and 315 mV at 10 mA/cm² under the authors’ alkaline three-electrode protocol. These values are assay-specific, not device performance.
